name: webgpu-q
description: WebGPU quantum many-body + chemistry simulator — RHF/UHF/RKS/UKS DFT, MP2/CCSD/CCSD(T)/EOM-CCSD (PySCF-ported, ~14× median GPU (T)), size-gated density fitting (runRHFAuto family: exact-ERI small / streaming f64 DF large, with provenance), full polarizability + dispersion stack (TDHF/TDDFT/UKS-TDDFT/C₆), D2 dispersion, Foster-Boys + Pipek-Mezey localization, Molden/Cube/QCSchema/XYZ import/export. Browser-platform stack: Web Worker parallelism (SharedArrayBuffer), cross-machine swarm (free MQTT relay) for distributed HF + molecule screening, embedded Pyodide REPL with PySCF compare, drag-import (XYZ/PDB/MOL/SDF), PWA + offline + IndexedDB history, URL-as-citation. Runs in a browser tab.
